name: IT Law in Public Administrations: E-Government Act, IT Security and Procurement
description:
The seminar offers insights into IT law in public administrations which are targeted to 
 students who want to work in public administrations as well as to the ones who wish to work in the private sector and have government organizations as future customers. 

The seminar will be held by an expert in IT law working at the Bayerisches Staatsministerium für Digitales.

The seminar deals with
- basics of IT law in the public sector, 
- Online Access Act (OZG) and Bavarian Digital Act
- basics of law regarding IT security (basics BSI-Act, TKG und TMG, link to BayDSG),
- basics of law regarding IT procurement (GWB, VOL/A, VgV) and
- special contract requirements for IT contracts of the public sector (EVB-IT).
